安娜与面包店的计划(Anna and the the bakery Plan): 一篇关于美食烹饪的A2短文:安娜与格蕾丝的经历和小计划。
The weather was snowy that day. Anna learned a lot about science. Last Tuesday, Anna and Grace went to the noodle shop. Also, jenny folded paper cranes for the class display.
Anna wrote about the day in the diary. There are always many people at the bakery. Anna is reading a book about science. For example, the buns are cooked by steam.
Anna and Grace had great fun there. Anna hopes to visit Chengdu one day. It takes twenty minutes to get to the noodle shop by bike. She buys fresh bread every morning.
Anna wants to be a engineer in the future. Grace's birthday is in September. Both of them like soup and milk.
